properties.name: Square: viewpoint A
properties.observation: This is a familiar meeting place. I can wait here and watch people, although the traffic makes conversation difficult.

properties.name: Square: viewpoint B
properties.perspective: A person passing through with shopping
properties.observation: I want a clear route across the square. When the space is crowded, carrying bags through it feels tiring.

properties.name: Square: viewpoint C
properties.observation: I recognise the delivery routines and closing times here. The place feels different once the daytime visitors have left.
